reason: This payment moves 1156884630000 minor units (6 dp) of USDC and the mandate's per_transaction_ceiling is 700000 USDC, which is 700000000000 at the same scale. The payment exceeds it and is refused. The constraint breached is `actionScope.per_transaction_ceiling`. This figure is the EFFECTIVE ceiling: a deployment may tighten it below what the credential declares and may never raise it, so compare against the credential to see whether it was tightened.
